This file goes further than the master to exercise every slot the cdifProvenance schema offers: activity types from the CDIF activityType vocabulary, identifiers and descriptions, a full instrument description, software version, located places, procedures with steps and constants, vocabulary roles, an instrument calibration activity and a failed measurement attempt. Every fact beyond the Dagstuhl source is illustrative. See implementationTesting/APPROACHES.md for what this form keeps and loses.
